code: import os import json import time import random from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError # ========================================== # 配置区域 # ========================================== # 目标URL TARGET_URL = "https://www.chinabond.com.cn/xwgg/ggtz/xwgg_gsgg/gsgg_zytz_ath/" # 爬取时间范围 (用户指定) START_DATE = "2025-12-01" END_DATE = "2025-12-31" # 输出目录 OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" # 浏览器配置 HEADLESS = True # 是否无头模式 TIMEOUT = 30000 # 请求超时时间 (ms) # ========================================== # 核心功能函数 # ========================================== def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 清洗HTML内容： 1. 将相对路径图片/链接转换为绝对路径 2. 移除无用标签 """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, a['href']) # 移除脚本和样式 for script in soup(["script", "style"]): script.decompose() return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[WARN] 内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def extract_detail_content(page_url, html): """ 从详情页HTML中提取正文 """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser') # 尝试常见的正文容器选择器 (根据CMS常见结构推断) # 优先查找 TRS_Editor (常见的政府/国企网站编辑器类名) content_selectors = [ "div.TRS_Editor", "div.article_content", "div.content", "div.main_content", "div.detail_content", "div.rightContentBox", # 列表页右侧容器名，详情页可能沿用 "#content", "div.marketRight" # 兜底 ] content_html = "" for selector in content_selectors: element = soup.select_one(selector) if element: # 简单的文本密度检查，防止提取到空容器 if len(element.get_text(strip=True)) > 10: content_html = str(element) break # 如果还没找到，尝试提取 body if not content_html: body = soup.find('body') if body: content_html = str(body) return clean_html_content(content_html, page_url) def parse_date(date_str): """ 解析日期字符串，统一返回 YYYY-MM-DD 格式 支持格式: YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY-MM-DD """ if not date_str: return "" date_str = date_str.strip() try: # 尝试 2025/09/25 return datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y/%m/%d").strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except ValueError: try: # 尝试 2025-09-25 return datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d").strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except ValueError: return "" def save_results(articles, output_path): """保存结果为JSON""" result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "dateRange": { "start": START_DATE, "end": END_DATE }, "articles": articles } os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True) with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"[SUCCESS] 已保存 {len(articles)} 条数据到 {output_path}") # ========================================== # 爬虫主类 # ========================================== class ChinaBondCrawler: def __init__(self): self.articles = [] self.seen_urls = set() def run(self): with sync_playwright() as p: # 启动浏览器 (配置反爬参数) browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=HEADLESS, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" ) page = context.new_page() try: print(f"[INFO] 开始爬取: {TARGET_URL}") print(f"[INFO] 目标日期范围: {START_DATE} 至 {END_DATE}") page.goto(TARGET_URL, timeout=TIMEOUT) page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') has_next_page = True page_num = 1 while has_next_page: print(f"\n[INFO] 正在处理第 {page_num} 页...") # 提取列表数据 new_articles, should_continue = self.parse_list_page(page) # 处理详情页 for article in new_articles: if article['sourceUrl'] not in self.seen_urls: self.process_detail(context, article) self.articles.append(article) self.seen_urls.add(article['sourceUrl']) # 检查是否需要翻页 if not should_continue: print("[INFO] 已达到结束日期或无更多数据，停止翻页") break # 尝试翻页 has_next_page = self.go_to_next_page(page) if has_next_page: page_num += 1 # 随机延时 time.sleep(random.uniform(1, 3)) else: print("[INFO] 没有下一页了") except Exception as e: print(f"[ERROR] 爬取过程中发生错误: {e}") finally: browser.close() # 保存结果 filename = f"chinabond_news_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.json" output_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename) save_results(self.articles, output_path) def parse_list_page(self, page): """ 解析列表页 返回: (articles_list, should_continue) """ articles = [] should_continue = True # 获取所有列表项容器 # 根据页面分析: div.rightListContent 包含 span.rightListImport 和 span.rightListTime items = page.query_selector_all("div.rightListContent") if not items: print("[WARN] 未找到列表项，可能选择器失效或页面加载不完整") return [], False print(f"[INFO] 本页共找到 {len(items)} 条记录") for item in items: try: # 提取标题和链接 link_el = item.query_selector("span.rightListImport a") if not link_el: continue title = link_el.inner_text().strip() relative_link = link_el.get_attribute("href") full_link = urljoin(page.url, relative_link) # 提取日期 date_el = item.query_selector("span.rightListTime") date_text = date_el.inner_text().strip() if date_el else "" pub_date = parse_date(date_text) # 日期过滤逻辑 if not pub_date: print(f"[SKIP] 日期解析失败: {title}") continue # 检查日期范围 # 列表通常是倒序的 if pub_date > END_DATE: # 日期太新，跳过，继续往后找 continue elif pub_date < START_DATE: # 日期太旧，停止爬取 (假设列表按时间倒序) print(f"[STOP] 发现旧于开始日期的记录: {pub_date} < {START_DATE}") should_continue = False # 注意：这里不能直接 break，因为可能同一天有多条，或者排序不严格 # 但通常新闻列表是严格倒序的。为了保险，如果连续多条都小于开始日期才停止？ # 这里采用严格策略：一旦遇到小于开始日期的，且确认列表是倒序的，就停止。 # 考虑到置顶可能，建议只标记不添加，直到确认大部分都旧了。 # 简单起见，这里假设严格倒序。 break # 符合日期范围 article = { "title": title, "date": pub_date, "sourceUrl": full_link, "source": "中国债券信息网", "author": "", # 列表页无作者信息 "summary": "", "content": "" } articles.append(article) print(f"[FOUND] {pub_date} | {title}") except Exception as e: print(f"[ERROR] 解析列表项出错: {e}") continue return articles, should_continue def process_detail(self, context, article): """ 处理详情页，提取正文 """ page = None try: page = context.new_page() page.goto(article['sourceUrl'], timeout=TIMEOUT) # 等待正文加载 try: page.wait_for_selector("div.TRS_Editor, div.rightContentBox", timeout=5000) except: pass # 即使超时也尝试提取 html = page.content() article['content'] = extract_detail_content(article['sourceUrl'], html) # 简单的摘要提取 soup = BeautifulSoup(article['content'], 'html.parser') text = soup.get_text(strip=True) article['summary'] = text[:200] + "..." if len(text) > 200 else text # 尝试从详情页补充作者信息 (如果有) # 常见的 meta 标签或 info 区域 # 示例: except Exception as e: print(f"[ERROR] 获取详情页失败 {article['sourceUrl']}: {e}") finally: if page: page.close() def go_to_next_page(self, page): """ 尝试翻页 """ try: # 策略1: 查找 "下一页" 按钮 # 页面结构中有 next_btn = page.query_selector("a.pageNext") if next_btn: # 检查是否禁用 (通常禁用会有 disabled 属性或特定 class) # 这里假设如果没有 href 且点击没反应就是到底了 # 或者检查是否是最后一个元素 # 获取当前URL current_url = page.url # 点击 next_btn.click() # 等待URL变化或内容刷新 try: page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle', timeout=5000) except: pass # 检查URL是否变化 (对于静态分页，URL通常会变) if page.url != current_url: return True # 如果URL没变，可能是JS局部刷新，检查列表内容是否变化 # 这里简单处理：如果URL没变且是静态网站结构，可能就是没下一页了 # 但有些网站点击下一页URL确实不变。 # 针对该网站：href="index_115.html"，点击应该会跳转。 # 策略2: 如果点击没反应，尝试直接找下一页的页码链接 # 获取当前页码 current_page_el = page.query_selector("a.pageNum.pageChecked") if current_page_el: # 找下一个兄弟节点 next_sibling = current_page_el.evaluate_handle("el => el.nextElementSibling") if next_sibling: tag_name = next_sibling.evaluate("el => el.tagName") class_name = next_sibling.evaluate("el => el.className") if tag_name == "A" and "pageNum" in class_name: next_sibling.click() page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') return True return False except Exception as e: print(f"[WARN] 翻页失败: {e}") return False # ========================================== # 主程序入口 # ========================================== def main(): # 确保输出目录存在 if not os.path.exists(OUTPUT_DIR): os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR) crawler = ChinaBondCrawler() crawler.run() if __name__ == "__main__": main()
